description: The postToolUse hook must create ~/.ovld/logs before anything redirects into it. `ovld protocol record-touched` is invoked with `2>>"$LOG_FILE"`, and bash fails the entire command when the redirect target's directory is missing — so without the mkdir the hook silently records no touched files at all on a machine where the directory does not yet exist. Claude's equivalent hook has always had this line; Cursor's did not, which is why touched-file attribution could disappear on a first-run machine with no visible error.
